newsitem.title: SPAIN: CYCLING-INDURAIN SET TO LEAVE BANESTO, COULD SIGN FOR ONCE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-INDURAIN SET TO LEAVE BANESTO, COULD SIGN FOR ONCE.

text.p: Five-times Tour de France winner Miguel Indurain looks almost certain to leave Banesto when his contract expires at the end of the year.
"He's left us, I can't say anything else," said Banesto team director Jose Miguel Echavarri on Wednesday, "Perhaps he's got something against us, or against the team."
But Indurain continues to train hard, leading to intense media speculation that he will opt against retirement and sign for ONCE.
"He would be a great incorporation," said ONCE team director Manolo Saiz. Indurain's wife Marisa told reporters that no agreement had been reached with ONCE.

The future of Indurain has been a mystery since he pulled out of the Tour of Spain in September. Many commentators criticised Banesto for having forced the Olympic gold medallist to ride in the race against his wishes.
